events.name: Bash
events.head: Show pass.py usage and settable fields
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py --help 2>&1 | head -30; grep -n "spec\|title\|why" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find where the Tantra key field lives in admin and how pass.py set patches fields
events.input: $ grep -rniE "tantra messaging|tantra api key|tantra_api_key|tantra_key" cloud/src cloud/public cloud/centre 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-260 | head -20; ls cloud | head -30; sed -n '/^def cmd_set\|^def set_/,/^def /p' workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -50

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate the admin field label for the Tantra key and pass.py set fields
events.input: $ grep -rnoiE ".{120}tantra_key.{160}" cloud/admin-ui --include=*.html --include=*.js --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --exclude-dir=node_modules | head -6; grep -rnoiE "<h[1-4][^>]*>[^<]*(Tantra|Reminder|Messaging)[^<]*" cloud/admin-ui --exclude-dir=node_modules | head -10; grep -n "def cmd_set\|def do_set\|needs_from_owner\|\"spec\"\|'spec'" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the admin key field markup and pass.py function list
events.input: $ grep -n "tantra_key\|Tantra Messaging\|Tantra API key" cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | cut -c1-330 | head -8; sed -n 325,330p cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | cut -c1-400; grep -n "^def \|kv\[" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | sed -n 1,60p; git log --oneline -3 -- cloud/admin-ui/admin.js
